import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns

def task_func(goals, penalties):
    goals = list(goals)
    penalties = list(penalties)

    if len(goals) != len(penalties):
        raise ValueError("goals and penalties must have the same length")

    teams = [f"Team {i + 1}" for i in range(len(goals))]

    df = pd.DataFrame({
        "Team": teams,
        "Goals": goals,
        "Penalties": penalties
    })

    plot = sns.pairplot(df[["Goals", "Penalties"]])

    return df, plot
